Ui.Script:
-- The water track's height, in pixels; positions arrive as fractions of it. BENILLA_FISHING_TRACK = 268 BENILLA_FISHING_CAP = 6 -- Seconds the Angler badge stays after a bar, and a banner shows. BENILLA_FISHING_BADGE_LINGER = 3 BENILLA_FISHING_BANNER_SECS = 2.5 BENILLA_FISHING_ART = "Interface\\Benilla\\fishing\\"
-- An item's name and quality, when the client knows it. function BenillaFishing_Item(item) if not item then return nil, nil end local name, _, quality = GetItemInfo(item) return name, quality end
function BenillaFishing_QualityColor(quality) if quality and GetItemQualityColor then local r, g, b = GetItemQualityColor(quality) if r then return r, g, b end end return 1, 1, 1 end
-- The zone's three slices: two caps and the stretched middle, at `bottom` and `height` -- pixels up the track. function BenillaFishingReel_PaintZone(art, bottom, height) local name = "BenillaFishingReel" local cap = math.min(BENILLA_FISHING_CAP, height / 2) local slices = { { name .. "ZoneBottom", bottom, cap, 0.9, 1 }, { name .. "ZoneMid", bottom + cap, math.max(height - 2 * cap, 1), 0.1, 0.9 }, { name .. "ZoneTop", bottom + height - cap, cap, 0, 0.1 }, } for i = 1, 3 do local s = slices[i] local tex = getglobal(s[1]) tex:SetTexture(art) tex:SetTexCoord(0, 1, s[4], s[5]) tex:SetHeight(s[3]) tex:ClearAllPoints() tex:SetPoint("BOTTOM", "BenillaFishingReelWater", "BOTTOM", 0, s[2]) end end
-- Turns the reel by `angle` radians about its centre (the eight-number SetTexCoord). function BenillaFishingReel_Turn(angle) local c, s = math.cos(angle) * 0.5, math.sin(angle) * 0.5 local function at(x, y) return 0.5 + x * c - y * s, 0.5 + x * s + y * c end local ulx, uly = at(-1, -1) local llx, lly = at(-1, 1) local urx, ury = at(1, -1) local lrx, lry = at(1, 1) BenillaFishingReelReel:SetTexCoord(ulx, uly, llx, lly, urx, ury, lrx, lry) end
-- One frame of the bar from GetReelState(); false once no bar is open. function BenillaFishingReel_Paint(elapsed) local frame = BenillaFishingReel local active, zoneBottom, zoneHeight, fishPos, progress, chestShown, chestPos, chestFill, legendary, fishItem, fishInZone, reeling = GetReelState() if not active then frame:Hide() return false end local track = BENILLA_FISHING_TRACK local art = BENILLA_FISHING_ART BenillaFishingReel_PaintZone( art .. (fishInZone and "catch_zone_active" or "catch_zone"), zoneBottom * track, zoneHeight * track )
local name, quality = BenillaFishing_Item(fishItem) local r, g, b = BenillaFishing_QualityColor(quality) frame.fishName = name or frame.fishName BenillaFishingReelName:SetText(name or "") BenillaFishingReelName:SetTextColor(r, g, b) BenillaFishingReelFish:SetTexture(art .. (legendary and "fish_legend" or "fish")) BenillaFishingReelFishGlow:SetVertexColor(r, g, b) BenillaFishingReelFish:ClearAllPoints() BenillaFishingReelFish:SetPoint("CENTER", "BenillaFishingReelWater", "BOTTOM", 0, fishPos * track) BenillaFishingReelFishGlow:ClearAllPoints() BenillaFishingReelFishGlow:SetPoint("CENTER", "BenillaFishingReelFish", "CENTER", 0, 0)
if chestShown then BenillaFishingReelChest:ClearAllPoints() BenillaFishingReelChestBar:ClearAllPoints() BenillaFishingReelChest:Show() BenillaFishingReelChestBar:Show() BenillaFishingReelChest:SetPoint("CENTER", "BenillaFishingReelWater", "BOTTOM", 0, chestPos * track) BenillaFishingReelChestBar:SetPoint("TOP", "BenillaFishingReelChest", "BOTTOM", 0, -1) BenillaFishingReelChestFill:SetWidth(math.max(chestFill * 22, 0.01)) BenillaFishingReelChestFill:Show() else BenillaFishingReelChest:Hide() BenillaFishingReelChestBar:Hide() BenillaFishingReelChestFill:Hide() end
local fill = BenillaFishingReelProgressFill fill:SetHeight(math.max(progress * track, 0.01)) if progress < 1 / 3 then fill:SetVertexColor(0.9, 0.2, 0.15) elseif progress < 2 / 3 then fill:SetVertexColor(1, 0.7, 0.1) else fill:SetVertexColor(0.3, 0.9, 0.3) end
if reeling then frame.reelAngle = (frame.reelAngle or 0) + (elapsed or 0) * 8 BenillaFishingReel_Turn(frame.reelAngle) end frame:Show() return true end
-- The Angler badge and XP bar from GetAnglerInfo(). function BenillaFishingAngler_Paint() local level, xp, toNext = GetAnglerInfo() BenillaFishingAnglerLevel:SetText(level) local share = 1 if toNext and toNext > 0 then share = math.min(xp / toNext, 1) end BenillaFishingAnglerFill:SetWidth(math.max(share * 124, 0.01)) BenillaFishingAnglerText:SetText("Angler " .. level .. " · " .. xp .. " / " .. toNext) end
function BenillaFishingBanner_Show(caught, perfect, treasure) local banner = BenillaFishingBanner local text if caught then local name = BenillaFishing_Item(caught) or BenillaFishingReel.fishName or "a fish" text = "Caught: " .. name if perfect then text = text .. " Perfect!" end if treasure then text = text .. " Treasure!" end BenillaFishingBannerArt:SetTexture(BENILLA_FISHING_ART .. "banner_success") banner.success = true else text = "It got away" BenillaFishingBannerArt:SetTexture(BENILLA_FISHING_ART .. "banner_fail") banner.success = false end BenillaFishingBannerText:SetText(text) banner.hideAt = GetTime() + BENILLA_FISHING_BANNER_SECS banner:Show() end
function BenillaFishing_OnEvent() local controller = BenillaFishingController if event == "FISHING_REEL_START" then BenillaFishingReel.fishName = nil controller.badgeUntil = nil elseif event == "FISHING_REEL_END" then BenillaFishingBanner_Show(arg1, arg2, arg3) controller.badgeUntil = GetTime() + BENILLA_FISHING_BADGE_LINGER end BenillaFishingAngler_Paint() end
function BenillaFishing_OnUpdate(elapsed) local controller = BenillaFishingController local now = GetTime() local open = BenillaFishingReel_Paint(elapsed) if open then controller.badgeUntil = nil BenillaFishingAngler:Show() elseif controller.badgeUntil and now < controller.badgeUntil then BenillaFishingAngler:Show() else BenillaFishingAngler:Hide() end local banner = BenillaFishingBanner if banner:IsShown() and banner.hideAt and now >= banner.hideAt then banner:Hide() end end
